_comment: Auditable manual corrections for the SC2Map card extraction (card_extractor.py).
'units' maps SC2 unit ids to {name, value}; 'cards' maps card name keys to field overrides.
Only add an entry the map itself cannot answer: a unit whose display name is not in the
map's localization (base-game units), or whose Minerals+Vespene cost cannot be read off
UnitData.xml. Values below were derived from data/v20260826_card.json card totals,
or are zero because the unit is a visual prop.
The three name-only entries correct data/maps/unit_info.json, which names Reaver
毁灭者 (the name the game gives VoidRayTaldarim) and PrimalFlyer 原始异龙 (the name it
gives PrimalMutalisk); both collisions disagree with data/v20260826_card.json.
The 'patched-cost' group at the end exists because the map's UnitData.xml is a *patch*
layer: at runtime UnitTypeGetCost resolves base game + dependency mods + map patch, but
star_tavern_cards.resolved_costs only sees the patch. A unit that patches one resource
loses the other, so the extracted price came out short. Each value is the figure the game
displays, pinned by the card equations in data/v20260826_card.json (the witness card is
named on each line). Verify with: uv run python scripts/audit_card_prices.py
Tosh 600 and SpartanCompany 250 are deliberately absent: the card equations could not
settle either one, and the values confirmed against the live game turned out to equal the
map's own patch, so constants/unit_prices.py was corrected instead of overriding here.

ImmortalShakuras._why: 不朽者(精英): patch has Vespene 250 only, base Minerals 250 lost; 一鼓作气 = 4*500 = 2000

Bunker2._why: 地堡: patch has Minerals 400 only; 孤军奋战 = 500 + 2*200 + 2*125 = 1150

MutaliskViper._why: 异龙(精英): patch has Minerals 200 only; 军事学院 1800 / 空中管制 1600 / 入景随风 2400

Monitor.name: 浩劫
Monitor._why: patch has Minerals 100 only; 鲜血猎手 = 6*125 + 200 = 950, 战时经济 = 2*150 + 2*200 + 2*300 = 1000

Reaver.name: 掠夺者
Reaver._why: absent from the map's UnitData.xml; 净化者军团 1400 / 菲尼克斯 2100

Stetmann._why: patch has Minerals 150 only; 斯台特曼 = 175 + 4*275 = 1275

HelsAngelAssault._why: 维京战机(精英): patch has Minerals 175 only; 斯台特曼 = 175 + 4*275 = 1275

HelsAngelFighter._why: 维京战机(精英) flight mode - same display name, kept equal to HelsAngelAssault; no card holds it
